whenToUse: The first sentence of an assistant or chatbot.
It can be replayed once more.
whenNotToUse: Long paragraphs or several sentences (people wait to read).
Text that must be read right away, such as buttons or notices.
Endless loops of deleting and rewriting.

alternatives.name: Rotating Words
alternatives.reason: Changing just one word at a time.

accessibility: Screen readers get the whole sentence from the start via sr-only text.
The typed letters and the cursor are aria-hidden.
With reduced motion, the whole sentence shows at once and the cursor doesn't blink.
At 70ms per character, a short sentence finishes in about a second.
